# BRUMA

> BRUMA is a clinic-grade peptide skincare brand from Kuwait: creams, serums and masks for home, sold online in Kuwait from 2027, and freeze-dried peptide serum kits supplied to aesthetic clinics (for professional use in clinics only).

Website: https://brumakw.com/
Pages: https://brumakw.com/ (home), https://brumakw.com/collection (the full range), https://brumakw.com/science (how it works), https://brumakw.com/about (what BRUMA is), https://brumakw.com/routine (find your routine), https://brumakw.com/creators (for creators), https://brumakw.com/privacy (privacy).
Method: Fresh Activation. Kept dry. Activated fresh.
Language: English (Arabic to follow).

## What BRUMA sells

### Brightening line: a cream, a toner, a lotion, a serum and a mask for brighter-looking skin, for home.
- BRUMA N°15 Cream, brightening cream (jar): A daily cream for brighter-looking skin.
- BRUMA N°16 Toner, brightening toner (bottle): A light toner for brighter-looking skin.
- BRUMA N°17 Lotion, brightening lotion (bottle): An everyday lotion for brighter-looking skin.
- BRUMA N°18 Bright, brightening serum (bottle): A serum for the look of dark spots and dullness.
- BRUMA N°19 Glow, brightening mask (box with sachets): A sheet mask for a fresh, glowing look.

### Eye line: creams, essences and patches for the eye area, for home.
- BRUMA N°08 Rest, freeze-dried eye mask (box with sachets): Eye patches for a rested, refreshed look.
- BRUMA N°11 Lift, eye contour cream (click-pen): For an eye contour that looks smoother and more lifted.
- BRUMA N°12 Awake, dark circle eye cream (tube with massage tip): For the look of dark circles and tired eyes.
- BRUMA N°13 Aurora, eye essence cream (jar): A light cream for fresh, rested-looking eyes.
- BRUMA N°14 Roller, eye massage essence (roll-on): A cooling roll-on for the look of puffiness around the eyes.

### Repair line: creams, a serum and a mask for home, given by clinics as aftercare and sold online from 2027.
- BRUMA N°07 Restore, firming freeze-dried mask (box with sachets): A sheet mask for skin that looks firmer and feels smooth.
- BRUMA N°09 Soothe, peptide repair cream (jar): A rich cream for skin that feels calm and comfortable.
- BRUMA N°10 Repair, peptide repair serum (bottle): A light serum for skin that looks smoother and feels cared for.

### Clinic kits (N°01-04), for clinics only, not sold to consumers: freeze-dried peptide serums, activated in the clinic (Fresh Activation) and used on the skin after treatments.
- BRUMA N°01 Copper, peptide glow serum (2-vial kit, 5 ml): For a fresh, healthy-looking glow after a treatment.
- BRUMA N°02 Firm, anti-wrinkle serum (2-vial kit, 5 ml): For skin that looks smoother and feels firmer.
- BRUMA N°03 Hydra, hydrating glow serum (2-vial kit, 5 ml): For skin that looks plump, dewy and rested.
- BRUMA N°04 Tone, even-tone glow serum (2-vial kit, 5 ml): For a more even-looking skin tone.

Each clinic kit: Part A freeze-dried powder, 0.1 g · Part B serum, 5 ml.

## Key facts

- BRUMA products are cosmetics for use on the skin only. Nothing BRUMA sells is injected.
- The full ingredient list is printed on every BRUMA box, in English and Arabic.
- Fresh Activation: BRUMA clinic serums are freeze-dried, a powder vial and a serum vial, activated in the clinic just before use, so the serum is fresh. Kept dry. Activated fresh.
- Registration of BRUMA products with the Kuwait Ministry of Health: in progress.
- BRUMA makes no medical claims. Its products help skin look smoother, firmer, more even or brighter; they do not treat conditions.
- The clinic kits (N°01-04) are for professional use in clinics only and are not sold to consumers; the home products are what BRUMA sells to people.

## Questions people ask

### What is a peptide?
A peptide is a short chain of amino acids, the building blocks of proteins. Your skin makes its own peptides. In skincare, peptides are used to help skin look smoother, firmer and more even. BRUMA uses peptides in freeze-dried clinic serums (Fresh Activation) and in creams, serums and masks for your routine at home.

### What does peptide skincare do?
Peptide skincare is used to help skin look smoother, firmer and more even, and to help it feel hydrated and comfortable. It is a cosmetic, not a medicine: it changes how skin looks and feels, and BRUMA makes no claims beyond that. The BRUMA range covers clinic serums and, for home, a Repair line, an Eye line and a Brightening line.

### What is Fresh Activation, and why does BRUMA freeze-dry its serums?
Fresh Activation is how a BRUMA clinic kit works: the peptides are kept as a dry, freeze-dried powder and activated with a serum just before use, so the serum is fresh when it goes on your skin. Each kit has two vials: Part A, freeze-dried powder, 0.1 g, and Part B, serum, 5 ml. The clinic activates them before a treatment.

### Are BRUMA products injected?
No. BRUMA products are for use on the skin only and are never injected. The clinic serums go on the skin after laser, skin boosters and other treatments, and the home creams, serums and masks are used like any other skincare. Every box says so, in English and Arabic.

### Who are the BRUMA clinic kits for?
BRUMA clinic kits are for professional use in aesthetic clinics in Kuwait only, on the skin after laser, skin boosters and other treatments; they are not sold to consumers. There are four kits, N°01 Copper, N°02 Firm, N°03 Hydra and N°04 Tone, each with a freeze-dried powder vial and a serum vial. Clinics use them under the BRUMA label or their own, and BRUMA trains the clinic staff.

### When and where will BRUMA be sold in Kuwait?
The BRUMA home products, the Repair, Eye and Brightening lines, will be sold online in Kuwait in 2027. Until then, BRUMA works with aesthetic clinics across Kuwait, which use the clinic kits during treatments and give the home products as aftercare. The clinic kits themselves are for clinics only. Request an invitation on WhatsApp and BRUMA will message you once, when the shop opens.

### How do I request an invitation to BRUMA?
You request an invitation on WhatsApp: tap "Request an invitation" on this page and send the message that opens. BRUMA will message you once, when the shop opens in 2027, and not before. There is no account to create and no form to fill in.

### How does a clinic get a BRUMA test kit?
A clinic requests a BRUMA test kit on WhatsApp: tap "I run a clinic" on the homepage and send the message that opens. You try the kits before you order, and BRUMA trains your staff. The serums can carry the BRUMA label or your clinic's own.

### Is the full ingredient list available?
Yes. The full ingredient list is printed on every BRUMA box, in English and Arabic, so you can read it before you use the product. BRUMA products are cosmetics for use on the skin only. Registration of BRUMA products with the Kuwait Ministry of Health is in progress.

### Is BRUMA suitable for sensitive skin?
Check the full ingredient list on the box and patch test first. Every BRUMA product lists every ingredient in English and Arabic, so you and your clinic can see exactly what is in it. If you have a skin condition or a known reaction to an ingredient, ask your clinic before using any skincare.
